description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to an buyUrl (product /dp or desk search). ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. Does not invent tracking tags — when unset, URLs omit tag= and tagConfigured is false. OpenAPI: resolveProduct.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es, en-US

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, se, de. REQUIRED — pass the user's storefront; curated ASINs only produce /dp links when trusted for that marketplace.

name: resolve_product
title: Resolve buy / product link
